name: IT Incident Management
tasks: Log the incident in the ITSM Platform
Document the diagnosis in the ticket
Escalate the ticket to the Incident Manager
Verify the resolution with the End User
Close the ticket in the ITSM Platform
Send the satisfaction survey to the End User
notes: XOR count: major-incident decision, both-cases merge, escalation decision, rework merge. AND pair models the parallel communicate/restore step.
